findings.summary: Graded Low: case (e) has a p95 of 4.95 s, not exactly 5 s, so promtool does not test the strictly-above boundary; the static test refuses a >= 5 rule instead.
Graded Low: the README lists the stack_only deselect count but not the new docker_only one, and its reviewer section does not yet link the alert's evidence run.
Graded Low: if Docker stopped answering in CI the promtool tests would be deselected and CI would stay green, with only the printed count showing it.
Graded Low: the alert test imports PyYAML, which is only a transitive dev dependency through openapi-spec-validator.
Graded Low: the case (f) comment says the lone sample has left the window at 600 s, when it is the last zero-valued sample that leaves it.
Graded Low: no mutation changes the label name inside the environment or version template, although the equality check would refuse it.
